note: Status is computed from the dates on the day the map is built. Several sources are press or commercial articles whose dates disagree: confirm on the official site before relying on a deadline. Update this file when a new call is announced.

grants.name: Bonus Ristrutturazioni 2026 (home renovation tax deduction)
grants.what: Tax deduction of 50% for a primary home (36% for others) on asbestos removal, transport and disposal, up to 96,000 euros of spending per home. No credit transfer or discount on the invoice.
grants.close_meaning: spending must be paid by this date; the rates fall in 2027
grants.next_call: Rates for 2027 set by the next budget law

grants.name: INAIL Bando ISI 2025, Axis 3 (asbestos removal)
grants.what: Non-repayable grant of 65% of costs, up to 130,000 euros per company, for removing asbestos-containing materials; an extra up to 20,000 euros at 80% for added work such as solar panels.
grants.close_meaning: applications closed; completion for admitted applicants ended 26 October 2026
grants.next_call: ISI 2026 not announced yet: watch inail.it

grants.name: Parco Agrisolare 2026 (PNRR, run by GSE)
grants.what: Up to 80% non-repayable for solar panels on farm buildings; asbestos removal is an eligible cost together with the solar installation. Works within 18 months of the grant.
grants.next_call: No new window announced: watch gse.it and masaf.gov.it

grants.name: Regione Lombardia 2026, asbestos removal from public buildings
grants.what: Local councils, unions of councils, mountain communities, provinces and the Metropolitan City of Milan only: up to 100% of eligible costs, up to 350,000 euros per project, 11.5 million euros in total.

grants.name: Municipal grants
grants.what: Some councils fund asbestos removal from their own budget. Ask the council's environment office.

obligations: In Lombardy the owner of a building with asbestos-cement must report it to the local health authority (ATS, form NA/1) and have its condition assessed with the Degradation Index (d.d.g. Sanita 13237/2008); the index decides whether removal is due within 12 months, later, or after periodic re-checks. Removal must be done by a company registered with the Albo Gestori Ambientali (category 10A or 10B).
